findings.summary: A direct storage hit returns a persisted job when the Gemini page sends no jobId. A manual or stale tab can receive the prompt and job contract without proving it is the managed URL for that job.
evidence: extension/background/actions/claim-gemini-job.js accepts directJob whenever present; the mismatch guard runs only when expectedJobId is truthy.
extension/content/content_gemini.js derives expectedJobId from the URL and sends undefined for a manual page.
extension/background/jobs-lifecycle.js always generates a jobId, inserts it into the managed URL, and persists it under gemini_job_<canonicalTabId>.
The new action regression test with a stored gemini_job_777 and no request.jobId fails: the response includes the stale job and prompt.

content_gemini.js also has a compatibility fallback after an unanswered CLAIM_GEMINI_JOB; its storage check accepts any job when expectedJobId is absent, so the same stale-tab case remains possible on that fallback path.
findings.required_change: Require an exact, non-empty expectedJobId match before returning any directly keyed job, and apply the same condition in the content script's compatibility storage fallback. Add regression tests for both paths, including a manual tab with a stale direct record.

findings.summary: The current Bible omits concrete runtime wiring and production consumer traceability for the action, despite asserting contracts that depend on those components.
evidence: The current Bible blob 0fb29a7138b7b3a0edee1e948bc337129b2d3b10 has no references to extension/content/content_gemini.js, extension/background.js, extension/background/jobs-lifecycle.js, or the CLAIM_GEMINI_JOB router mapping.
extension/background/router.js maps CLAIM_GEMINI_JOB to claim-gemini-job and applies action source validation.
extension/background.js loads the action and its routeRegisteredAction contextFactory injects state, ensureInitialized, and initializeTabIdentity().
extension/background/jobs-lifecycle.js generates job IDs, inserts jobId into the managed Gemini URL, persists gemini_job_<canonicalTabId>, and updates jobIndex before the claim.
extension/content/content_gemini.js extracts and trims jobId from the URL and sends CLAIM_GEMINI_JOB.
The previous Bible blob had explicit runtime wiring and consumer sections; those details disappeared in the current revision.
findings.required_change: Restore concrete production wiring, producer, consumer, and canonical-identity references in the Bible, clearly distinguishing production paths from isolated test evidence.
